content.title: AppTech Payments announces $5M common equity raise, reduces board size
content.summary: AppTech Payments (APCX) announced that AFIOS Partners invested $5M in the common stock of the Company. In connection with the transaction, the Company reduced its Board to five members from seven and appointed Albert Lord, Thomas Kozlowski Jr., and Calvin Walsh to its Board of Directors. As of December 16, 2024, the Company had received $2.5M of the $5M capital commitment.
